issue.title: Sunset the llm_provider.retry.sase entry in favor of agent auto-restart

task_type_fields.proposal: Evaluate and retire the llm_provider.retry.sase retry entry now that update-skew agent auto-restart (epic sase-1j6) recovers sase-originated pre-provider failures, so one mechanism owns them (proposed by sase-1j6.9).
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: Epic sase-1j6 deliberately left provider retry behavior untouched; retiring the retry entry needs its own evaluation of what it still covers.

issue.creation_reason: Proposed by sase-1j6.9 (land phase of epic sase-1j6): two mechanisms now react to sase-originated failures; the retry entry should retire once auto-restart covers it.
